text:
jun: quick triage — Nimbus reported a customer-private onboarding for Sirocco-3p2b. After our int8 quant they see instruction-following collapse, hallucinations up. asked if we can prioritize a smoke triage today.

marta: thanks. do we have a repro prompt and sample outputs? can you drop a short pair? :eyes:

jun: pasted from customer (redacted):
```
User: Summarize the policy for refund eligibility in plain bullets.
Model (float16): Refunds are issued for defective goods within 30 days; proof required; contact support.
Model (int8): The refund policy is complicated; sometimes returns are accepted but not always. We will not help.
```

chen: hmm that looks like a qualitative degradation not just tokenization. first checks: tokenizer mismatch, special tokens, padding/truncation, and calibration dataset for quant. also confirm they used our recommended per-channel int8 recipe.

liam: @chen FYI I already ran a quick quant smoke on private cluster 3 using our default calib (2k samples) and got similar behavior on a local prompt set. logging here: link: https://redwood-internal/run/sirocco-3p2b/quick-quant-1729 (private)

marta: good call. action items:
- reproduce on our eval harness with full instruction-following suite (IF-200).
- run float16 baseline + int8 per-channel + int8 per-tensor + 4-bit q4_0 to compare.
- grab logit diffs, top-1 token divergence, and NLL deltas for IF-200.
- check tokenizer id mapping for command tokens.

jun: starting reproduction now. one quick ask: which quant script/flags to use so it's comparable to customer?

chen: use our canonical script. example run: 
```
python infra/quantize.py \
  --model-path /mnt/models/sirocco-3p2b/float16 \
  --out /tmp/sirocco-int8-perc \
  --dtype int8 \
  --per_channel True \
  --calibration-samples 2048 \
  --batch 8
```
Then eval with: 
```
python infra/eval_if.py --model /tmp/sirocco-int8-perc --suite IF-200 --save-logs /tmp/if-int8.json
```

liam: will also run per-tensor and q4_0. tagging @ops-bot for a slot on the dedicated GPU queue; need 1xA100-p4d for ~30m.

ops-bot: booked 2024-09-18T14:10:00Z on cluster-dedicated-3 for 45m (job id: bk-7721).

marta: nice. once we have IF-200 numbers, let's compute: overall pass rate, instruction-following BLEU-ish score (we use the IF-sim metric), and an actionability metric. if int8 drops >10% vs f16 on IF-sim, escalate to model team and mark as "quantization-blocking".

jun: quick notes from reproduction (initial): int8 per-channel shows a 12% drop on IF-sim, per-tensor ~20% drop, q4_0 ~6% drop but much lower throughput. tokenizer mapping is identical to our catalog. calibration logs show large outlier ranges on attention projection weights.

chen: that points to sensitivity in projection matrices — try per-channel symmetric vs asymmetric and increase calibration samples to 8k. also try clipping extreme ranges before quant. add this experiment: 
```
python infra/quantize.py --model-path ... --dtype int8 --per_channel True --calibration-samples 8192 --clip 0.999
```

marta: good. customer ask: they want an ETA for private deployment and whether we can suggest a fallback. propose messaging: "we've identified quant-sensitivity in specific weight groups; we can either (a) serve float16 on Dedicated, (b) use 4-bit Q4_0 for lower-cost but slower, or (c) apply targeted mixed-precision for sensitive layers — we can prototype (c) by EOD."

jun: favor (c). i'll try mixed-precision: keep projections at f16, quantize rest to int8. quick patch: 
```
python infra/quantize.py --mixed-precision "proj:float16" --calibration-samples 4096 ...
```

liam: ran 4 experiments and pushing results to dashboard. preliminary: mixed-precision recovers ~9% of IF-sim drop (int8 -> -3% vs f16). q4_0 recovers ~7% but has 2x latency. per-tensor remains bad.

marta: perfect. next steps:
- @jun finish mixed-precision prototype and produce artifact + SHA for customer to try in private environment.
- @liam upload eval artifacts + plots (logit-diff hist, top-token divergence).
- @chen run extended calib (8k) and symmetric quant variant.
- I'll draft customer message with options and recommended path (mixed-precision trial + fallback to f16 if needed).

jun: timeline: prototype by EOD, will post model artifact link.

liam: dashboard link: https://redwood-internal/dashboard/sirocco-3p2b/1729 (private).

ops-bot: note added to ticket RW-4941: "Sirocco 3p2b quant degradation" assigned to eng-ml.

marta: thanks team. if mixed-precision looks stable we'll add a short runbook to onboarding checklist: "if per-channel int8 drops >8% on IF-sim -> try mixed-precision pinned to projection matrices, increase calibration samples, then consider 4-bit fallback." :white_check_mark:

chen: one more — add tokenizer edge-case tests to onboarding harness (we found rare token merges change conditioning). I'll open PR to add 10 targeted prompts.

jun: PR + artifact links will be in thread by 1729008250.

liam: will follow up with perf numbers and costs for each option.

marta: closing loop here; will update customer after artifacts land. :metal:
